messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-4521 - node/unhealthy/gpu-node-17 is NotReady (no kubelet heartbeat). Impact: several pods on node failed liveness -> 502s for inference-route-prod. Auto-escalation to oncall_eng.

alex (oncall): ack. I see spikes in 502s on the dashboard. Pulling node details now.

mari: taking a look at node from k8s controlplane. `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-17 -o wide` shows NotReady, last heartbeat 2m ago.

devin: @alex do we have a replacement pool? can we scale up dedicated capacity to drain traffic?

alex (oncall): yes we have spare in dedicated-capacity-us-west. Scaling replicaset to push 3 extra pods to other nodes. Doing `kubectl scale --replicas=5 deployment/inference-route-prod`.

ops-bot: Autoscaler event: increased deployment/inference-route-prod replicas from 2 to 5. New pods pending.

mari: kubelet logs on gpu-node-17 show repeated IO errors then connection closed. grabbing journal: ```
-- journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 --no-pager --no-hostname
Jul 14 21:02:07 kernel: [  123.456789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
Jul 14 21:02:09 systemd: Stopping kubelet.service...
Jul 14 21:02:10 kernel: [  125.000123] CPU 3: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#3 stuck for 22s
```

devin: that Xid 79 usually means GPU driver/kernel crash. Could be host-level kernel panic or NV driver OOM.

cloud-eng: I'm opening a support ticket with cloud provider for host replacement (ticket #CLD-9982). Will request hypervisor host reboot + disk integrity check.

alex (oncall): No time to drain gracefully. Marking node unschedulable: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17` and then `kubectl delete pod --force --grace-period=0` for affected inference pods so they reschedule.

mari: done: node cordoned. Deleting stuck pods. New pods landed on gpu-node-12/gpu-node-9. Traffic metrics improving.

incident-bot: PD-4521 acknowledged by alex (oncall).

devin: quick check: are any customers reporting degraded SLOs? Product dashboard shows error rate peaked at 4.6% over 5m for /generate. Notified customer-success to flag high-visibility customers.

alex (oncall): @sre-lead, tagging for priority follow-up and postmortem. Need decision on reimaging vs immediate reprovision.

sre-lead: On it. If cloud team confirms kernel crash, reimage is safest. Keep the node isolated for root cause. Also want kernel oops + dmesg saved; mari, please snapshot `/var/log/dmesg` and `journalctl -k`.

mari: saved logs to internal bucket: <https://internal.storage/redwood-logs/gpu-node-17/1769001123-logs.tar.gz> and attached short excerpt above.

cloud-eng: cloud provider confirmed host is deadlocked; hardware GPU card reported fatal error. They scheduled host replacement and will reprovision by 22:10 UTC. Ticket CLD-9982 updated.

alex (oncall): handoff note: if replacement slips past 22:05 UTC, escalate to infra-manager. I'll stay on until pods stable and error rate <1% for 2 consecutive 5m windows.

devin: customer-success pinged top-tier customers with templated message. No active incidents reported by customers yet, but monitoring closely.

ops-bot: Alert summary: PD-4521 | Node NotReady gpu-node-17 | Acknowledged by alex (oncall) | Status: mitigated (pods rescheduled) | Provider ticket: CLD-9982.

alex (oncall): Confirming final state for now: node offline, workloads migrated, autoscale compensated. Keeping incident open until host reprovisioned and logs analyzed. Creating incident doc: <https://go.redwood/incident/PD-4521> 

sre-lead: Post-incident actions: (1) collect kernel oops/driver versions, (2) verify we have quantized fallback for this class of GPU failures, (3) run a sweep to ensure no other nodes show similar errors. Will own the postmortem.

mari: attaching quick root-cause evidence in the doc; note: NV driver 525.89.02 on node.

cloud-eng: host reprovision complete at 22:07 UTC, new host is gpu-node-17-reprovisioned. We left old host logs with support.

alex (oncall): rejoined node to cluster? `kubectl uncordon gpu-node-17-reprovisioned` done, pods scheduled, verifying health.

devin: error rate back down to 0.7% and latency normal. Marking degraded service resolved.

incident-bot: PD-4521 resolved by alex (oncall) at 1769001287.

alex (oncall): postmortem will include remediation: upgrade NV driver, add host-level GPU health checks to detect early signs, and automate failover to dedicated pool when host-level GPU Xid 79 occurs.

sre-lead: thanks team. I'll kick off the postmortem doc and follow-up actions.

mari: adding note for oncall handoff—night shift should verify GPU driver rollouts that are scheduled this week.

alex (oncall): closing thread after postmortem link posted. :checkered_flag:
